# UI Redesign Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers-extended-cc:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers-extended-cc:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Replace the teal-heavy palette with Sand & Stone, compact the hero, fix layout bugs from dead CSS, add social links, and update blog article pages to match.

**Architecture:** Single-file static site (majestic-travels-blog.html) with blog pages generated by scripts/build-blog.js from posts/*.md. The homepage CSS lives in an inline `<style>` tag (lines 62–2546). Blog article pages inherit that CSS via build-blog.js's `getHomeParts()` which extracts the `<style>` block, then `articleHtml()` appends article-specific styles. So homepage CSS changes automatically propagate to blog pages on next build. The article template in `articleHtml()` also has its own nav/footer HTML that needs social links added.

**Tech Stack:** HTML, CSS, vanilla JS, Node.js build script

### Task 2: Compact hero and constrain featured post

- [ ] `.featured-card` has `max-height: 240px` (desktop)
- [ ] `.featured-media` has `max-height: 240px` and `overflow: hidden`

**Steps:**

  Change:

  .nav-socials {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.5rem;

    margin-left: 0.5rem;

  .nav-socials a {
    display: grid;

    display: flex;
    gap: 0.5rem;

    width: 32px;
